dedupe_keys.name: connected urban twins cut open urban digital twin components and resources

description: Connected Urban Twins was a joint project of Hamburg, Leipzig and Munich on urban digital twins and urban data platforms, and its downloads page publishes the project's freely available results for reuse by other cities. Results can be filtered by category (applications and technologies, use cases, citizen participation, urban research, urban data platforms, urban digital twins) and by city, and include links to code on OpenCoDE, documentation and guidance. Items on the page read include the concept architecture of the Munich digital twin based on DIN SPEC 91607, FROST-Server deployments of the OGC SensorThings API with multi-tenancy and Keycloak, a Docker Compose setup as used in Leipzig, an Apache Superset extension for OGC WFS data sources, a DCAT-AP bridge from the Leipzig geodata catalogue to the open data portal, the Urban Model Builder add-on for Masterportal, and a report on a national building and dwelling register. The material is free; licences are set per code repository and no single licence is stated on the page. Caveats: the page and most documents are in German, and components are building blocks, not a ready digital twin. Coverage is Germany (the three cities). It supports building digital twins that link sensors and infrastructure data; there are no related records in the catalogue yet.
